title: The demo retention sweep runs once shortly after the web process starts, so a deployment that restarts more often than hourly still freezes and deletes demos; a demo site deleted through its own door reads deleted too
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL set: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/cron.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/website-opportunities-demo-retention.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the test named below.
expect: start() with a demoRetentionTick schedules one setTimeout at DEMO_RETENTION_FIRST_MS (under 10 minutes) besides the hourly interval; firing it runs the sweep exactly once; stop() clears both timers.
A site deleted through DELETE /api/sites/:key stamps every wo_build that pointed at it (demo_deleted_at, state 'deleted') once; other builds are untouched.
fence: the first run shares the hourly sweep's advisory lock, so replicas booting together still sweep once

tests: demo retention: start() schedules one sweep shortly after boot
a site deleted through its own door marks the builds that pointed at it deleted
